correctness.rationale: All main formulas reconstruct from the Lee–Wang parametrization. After scaling by 2(p-q)/(pq), the metric is diagonal with g_mumu=d(s cosh2mu+d)/P and g_thetatheta=d(s cosh2mu+d). The conformal-curvature formula gives K=-2Ps(s+d cosh2mu)/(d(s cosh2mu+d)^3). With t=tanh mu, K dA integrates to -4pi sqrt(P). The exact radial identity |Y|^2=d(s cosh2mu-d)/P cuts a ball to |mu|≤a and yields the stated area formula. Differentiating its ratio gives the displayed unique-max and unique-crossing scalar equations. The large-R expansion and the (2,1) Möbius half-cover formulas, numerical peak constants, and 2pi systole all check independently.

originality.rationale: Lee–Wang provide the explicit family, induced metric ingredients, and asymptotic cones; Braxton–Lee–Zhu provide the recent F-stability result for the Möbius quotient. Searches of current indexed/open material did not locate the exact total-curvature identity, centered Euclidean ball-area formula with its one overshoot/crossing law and logarithmic excess, or the Möbius systole. These are derivations from explicit prior geometry, so originality is qualified and deliberately limited to the assembled exact global invariants.

scientific_value.rationale: The package turns qualitative conical asymptotics into exact global area-growth information and exhibits a nonmonotone centered area ratio with a unique finite-radius maximum. The total-curvature and systolic identities give complementary intrinsic invariants for a newly important stable higher-codimension shrinker and its Lee–Wang family.

citations.note: Lee–Wang construction of the Hamiltonian-stationary shrinkers/expanders and their cone asymptotics; lawful open full text inspected.
Braxton–Lee–Zhu recent F-stability preprint for the embedded Möbius shrinker.
Castro–Lerma classification context for Hamiltonian-stationary self-similar Lagrangian surfaces.

findings: The metric, curvature, total-curvature, radial, and area formulas all rederive exactly.
The area-ratio derivative is proportional to 2P-ds a sinh(2a), giving one strict maximum; the density difference has a strictly increasing numerator and one crossing.
For (p,q)=(2,1), solving 3a sinh(2a)=4 reproduces a*=0.7000655576, R*=1.6512789741, and peak ratio 1.8448061591.
The systole lower bound is rigid under the Möbius deck transformation and gives exactly 2pi.
independent_checks: Derived Gaussian curvature from the conformal metric and integrated it after t=tanh(mu).
Integrated the area form over |mu|≤a and algebraically verified the radical/arcosh expression and large-radius expansion.
Differentiated the exact area ratio symbolically and recomputed the Möbius numerical constants.
Checked the systole using g≥4 dtheta^2+2 dr^2 and the deck generator (theta,r)↦(theta+pi,-r).
limitations: For general (p,q), the area is parameterized immersed area and counts multiplicity.
The result does not establish nonlinear flow stability or compact-flow occurrence.
Euclidean area ratio is distinct from Gaussian entropy/F-functional.
A forthcoming thesis on the same Möbius shrinker was not available for inspection, so originality remains qualified.
